# Hasan Tayyar Beşik

> Personal site of a DevOps Engineer at SumUp. Notes on automation, cloud operations, security, reliability, and Kubernetes plus music, visual work, and occasional papers.

The homepage is a personal landing page; longer writing lives under `/feed/`. Posts are short notes, monthly learning logs, audio and visual works, and paper summaries,  not formal documentation. Earlier multilingual writing is on Medium and being moved to here.

Contact email is shared at the main page.
PGP: https://keybase.io/hasantayyar/pgp_keys.asc

## Core pages

- [Home](https://hasantayyar.net/): Landing page with role, focus areas, and links
- [About](https://hasantayyar.net/about/): Short bio and professional context
- [Notes feed](https://hasantayyar.net/feed/): Paginated blog; snippets, links, ideas, and longer posts
- [RSS](https://hasantayyar.net/feed.xml): Latest posts
- [Sitemap](https://hasantayyar.net/sitemap.xml): Full URL index

## Topics by category

- [EIL / Everything I Learned](https://hasantayyar.net/feed/category/eil/): Monthly learning logs (tech, books, misc)
- [Studio](https://hasantayyar.net/feed/category/studio/): Creative work; music and visual projects
- [Notes](https://hasantayyar.net/feed/category/notes/): Short posts on security, cloud, tools, and links
- [Papers worth sharing](https://hasantayyar.net/feed/category/paper/): Summaries and quotes from academic papers
- [Music Works](https://hasantayyar.net/feed/category/music/): Listening notes, albums, and audio work
- [Visual Works](https://hasantayyar.net/feed/category/visual/): Generative art, animations, and image work
- [Books](https://hasantayyar.net/feed/category/books/): Reading notes and recommendations
- [Programming](https://hasantayyar.net/feed/category/programming/): Language and tooling notes (e.g. Elixir)
- [Project](https://hasantayyar.net/feed/category/project/): Small tools and side projects
